title: Providing Minimal-Sized Responses to DNS Queries That Have QTYPE=ANY
summary: Gives guidance on how authoritative DNS servers can respond to QTYPE=ANY queries with minimal-sized answers, since operators may choose not to give full responses for security or performance reasons. The DNS specification had no specific advice for this.

eli5.summary: If someone asks for everything you know, you may reply with just one small thing. This explains good ways to give a short answer.

questions: how to respond to qtype any
